name: Shaenfield Ranch Center
summary: Shaenfield Ranch Center is a well-regarded community shopping destination in northwest San Antonio featuring 42,958 square feet of retail, service, and restaurant space. The center is currently expanding with Phase II "The Portico," adding 54,000 square feet to serve the area's growing affluent residential communities.
demographics: Shaenfield Ranch Center serves the affluent northwest San Antonio market near Loop 1604, attracting upper-middle-income families and professionals from surrounding master-planned communities. The trade area consists primarily of homeowners aged 30-55 with household incomes exceeding $100,000, drawn to the area's highly-rated schools and suburban lifestyle. Shoppers typically seek convenient neighborhood retail for daily needs, dining, and services, with a preference for quality brands and family-friendly establishments that complement the area's upscale residential character.
description: Shaenfield Ranch Center is a thriving community retail destination strategically located at 7915 West Loop 1604 North in San Antonio's rapidly growing northwest corridor. Developed and managed by Dominion Advisory Group, Inc., this dynamic shopping center currently features 42,958 square feet of versatile space accommodating retail, service, and restaurant businesses that serve the surrounding affluent residential communities. The center is now pre-leasing Phase II, called "The Portico," which will add an impressive 54,000 square feet of additional space, nearly doubling the center's footprint and expanding its ability to serve the community. With a strong 4.6-star rating from 180 reviews, Shaenfield Ranch Center has established itself as a trusted neighborhood hub where local businesses thrive and residents find convenient access to quality shopping and dining options. The center's prime location in one of San Antonio's most desirable areas, combined with its commitment to creating a vibrant community atmosphere, makes it an ideal destination for both established retailers and emerging concepts looking to connect with an upscale customer base.
